source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical 756 _ewsifyConfig appends an EWS grant to config.incoming.oauthSettings.scope and then assigns scope from the provider on the next line, overwriting the appended value. This is a statically visible lost write; no authentication failure or review diagnosis is inferred. The newer accepted FindConfig no longer uses that sequence and protocol-specific provider scopes handle the separation. Proposed manual review rule: read the whole mutation branch and its final value, not only the line that appears to add the required permission.
title: Trace the final assignment after appending an OAuth scope
